change_policy: Hash the sorted repository-relative path and content digest of every regular file in src/, examples/, and go/, including compiled comparison consumers, automatically included Go files, assembly/cgo/embed inputs, tests, and assets. This deliberately includes non-behavioral source files. Keep build outputs outside these source directories. Cargo/Go manifests, judge/schema and optional build settings remain explicitly bound. A changed file set or contents requires review and a newly verified identity/export pin. Generated model/driver/origin, model lock, downstream FV consumer and CodeCommit stay outside this footprint. Python source modules under scripts/ are also inventoried, including newly added imports or standard-library shadows; generated bytecode is outside the source inventory. The operation table and pinned Poly/ML package configuration are explicit data inputs. New other transitive data inputs require policy review. The compiler, interpreter and CI host remain trusted. Inspect the repository root and every source path component with lstat before filtering or recursion. Reject symbolic links, Windows junctions/reparse points, non-regular entries, and regular files with multiple hard links; this includes otherwise filtered Python bytecode/non-.py entries. Optional paths may be absent only after all existing parent entries pass inspection. This assumes a fixed checkout during fingerprinting and does not remove compiler/interpreter/CI-host trust. Reference replay input vectors, capability contract, model/diagnostic schemas, and repository-owned finite/full consumer drivers are explicit source inputs. The external generated driver artifact remains separately pinned. All reference-model lock metadata remains excluded to preserve acyclicity. Typed wire projections, domain arities and response enum input/driver contracts are source inputs. Wire response artifact locks remain excluded; no result/commit/publication metadata is a model identity input. Full sender/client RPC, exact primitive broker/provider, mode3 absence, current-client inputs and dispatcher test-only observers/fixtures are source inputs. Source before/after images and execution outputs remain outside the input fingerprint. No public commit enters model identity or origin.
